name: github-pr-ops
description: Reference skeleton for GitHub PR operational workflows.

commands.name: review
commands.summary: Review a pull request and summarize readiness without mutating it.

arguments.name: pull_request_url
arguments.description: GitHub pull request URL to inspect.

commands.name: merge
commands.summary: Prepare or execute a merge decision under an explicit policy.

arguments.name: pull_request_url
arguments.description: GitHub pull request URL to merge.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record policy inputs, evidence, and decisions.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record plugin invocation and external GitHub context.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist plugin workflow state between invocations.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach externally verified execution or merge results.

permissions.reason: Read PR status, checks, reviews, and branch metadata.
Only needed for future merge/write workflows.
